annotations.title: Find a compound, outcome or protein

description: Search the Catalyst evidence graph by name or synonym (for example "magnesium", "vitamin D", "sleep", "creatine"). Returns node ids to pass to get_findings or get_relations. Each hit says how many findings it has, and hits with findings come first, so the first hit with findings above 0 is usually the one to use. It finds things; it does not say anything about them.
